task.title: P6-006: Decide whether the mobile filter sheet opens from the left or bottom
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 6 — Decisions the maintainer owns). Original id: P6-006. Size: S, decision first. Specs: specs/app-ui.md, specs/ui-design.md.

**The mobile filter sheet slides from the left; the frame draws a bottom sheet with a grabber.** `catalog/rail.rs:463` uses `SheetDirection::Left`, while `cards.rs:376` and `bench/sheet.rs:26` already use `SheetDirection::Bottom` — so the primitive supports it and this is a small change. It is unrecorded either way, so it needs a ruling rather than a silent choice by whoever picks it up.
